estimator: seed-17 dedicated motion CNN plus optional motion-and-forearm ridge head

frozen_motion.architecture: 2 channels, valid convolution width 3 to 16 outputs twice, ReLU after each, flatten in filter-major order; two standardized anchors and 6 phase flags; dense ReLU 32 to 2. Standardized change restored to degrees and added to anchor.

features: 64 bipolar EMG RMS bins (time then forearm pair)
correction.target: two measured absolute angles minus the held-person motion CNN absolute forecast in degrees
correction.scaling: Each continuous position has the unweighted six-person row mean and population SD, with exact zero SD replaced by one. Response and six slot flags are in native scale.
correction.weights: Each row of person p has weight 1/(6 * row_count[p]); continuous slopes receive penalty 0.01 in the weighted normal equations, phase intercepts unpenalized.

window.movement: visually cued supported right wrist pointing
window.eligibility: Original analysis required all six future target readings for each retained trial. Each forecast uses measurements up to its own cutoff.

historical_six_fold_errors.scope: Five-person fits evaluated on the remaining person within six previously used TRAIN people. The five-person correction targets came from four-person base fits. The separately trained all-six deployment has no unseen-person evaluation.
historical_six_fold_errors.metric: Equal-person equal-axis root mean squared error in degrees

distribution: One all-six CNN state, its motion scales and one all-six ridge state. Participant samples, trial identifiers, fold states and individual predictions remain with the source studies.
